args.body:
• Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data, with most savings coming from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• Companion piece (insights.bellwether.example/cold-chain/companion): pilot programs cut claims by roughly a quarter.
• Implication: real-time data sharing between carriers and shippers is the key lever for cold-chain cost reduction, mainly via avoided load rejections and claims.
args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026: Key Takeaways
